records.text: U1 MCP73831 controls charging of a single lithium-ion or lithium-polymer cell with constant-current and constant-voltage regulation.
U2 TLV755P is a low-dropout linear regulator supplying the portable sensor electronics.
U3 INA219 senses shunt voltage and bus voltage and reports electrical current and power through its I2C interface.
J1 is the external supply inlet. Pin 1 carries input power and pin 2 is the return.
J2 is the rechargeable-cell connector. Pin 1 is battery positive and pin 2 is battery negative.
D1 is the green charge-state indicator. It lights while the synthetic design reports charging.

records.text: U1 DRV8833 contains two H-bridges for driving brushed DC motors, a bipolar stepper, or other inductive loads.
U2 SN65HVD230 provides the physical transmit and receive interface between a CAN controller and the differential CAN bus.
U3 INA219 measures the shunt voltage and bus voltage to report motor-supply current and power over I2C.
J1 is the two-terminal connection to the brushed motor. The output bridge drives its two wires.
J2 exposes the CAN network. Pin 1 is CAN high and pin 2 is CAN low.
D1 is the red fault indicator used to display a motor-driver error in this synthetic design.

records.text: U1 LM358 is a dual operational amplifier. In this synthetic design it amplifies the first analog sensor signal.
U2 LM358 is a dual operational amplifier. In this synthetic design it amplifies the second analog sensor signal.
U3 ADS1115 is a 16-bit analog-to-digital converter with an I2C interface and a programmable gain amplifier.
U4 NE555 is a precision timer configured to generate repeating sampling pulses in this synthetic design.
J1 is the external sensor inlet. Pin 1 is the analog signal, pin 2 is return, and pin 3 is the sensor supply.
J2 accepts an external calibration signal. Pin 1 is the reference input and pin 2 is return.

records.text: U1 SN74HC00 contains four two-input NAND gates. This synthetic design uses it for the first digital logic bank.
U2 SN74HC00 contains four two-input NAND gates. This synthetic design uses it for the second digital logic bank.
U3 NE555 provides accurate timing and is configured as a one-shot pulse generator in this synthetic design.
U4 TLV755P is a low-dropout linear voltage regulator that powers the digital logic supply.
J1 is the trigger input connector. Pin 1 starts a timed pulse and pin 2 is the common return.
J2 carries the timed pulse output. Pin 1 is the output pulse and pin 2 is the common return.
